title: What is NAP in Local SEO? - Moz

facts.fact: Moz's consumer survey found that 52% of people will leave a negative review after finding false or incorrect online information on assets like local business listings.
facts.quote: we found that 52% of people will leave a negative review after finding false or incorrect online information on assets like local business listings.

facts.fact: Moz says its simple NAP review workflow takes under an hour to start reviewing and managing a business's NAP online.
facts.quote: Start with this simple workflow that will take under an hour to start reviewing and manaing tour NAP online:

facts.fact: In local SEO, NAP stands for name, address, and phone number, and when a website URL is included it is referred to as NAP+W.
facts.quote: In local SEO, NAP stands for name, address, and phone number. When a website URL is included, it's referred to as NAP+W.

facts.fact: Google has stated that it uses directories and listings to measure prominence, which Moz describes as a key factor in its local algorithm.
facts.quote: Google itself has stated that it uses directories and listings to measure prominence, a key factor in its local algorithm.

facts.fact: Moz advises that a business's NAP on its website should be in text format rather than stored in images.
facts.quote: Your NAP needs to be complete and accurate on your site — in text format, not stored in images.

facts.fact: Moz advises businesses with multiple locations to create a dedicated page for each location on their website.
facts.quote: If you have multiple locations create dedicated pages for each location.
